verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions Mastra Knowledge connecting to or consuming external MCP servers. The only integration evidence concerns connecting systems such as Slack and Monday to keep Knowledge current, which is a different capability from MCP client support. Plugging in MCP tools is a fair question for an agent-facing knowledge product, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
